title: Response Length Perception and  Sequence Scheduling: An LLM-Empowered LLM Inference Pipeline

layout.note: Two unframed panels split by a thick grey vertical rule: a narrow left one (vanilla batches, 66% box, legend underneath) and a wider right one where instructions, perception box, predicted-length bars, scheduling box and regrouped responses run left to right, with the failure recomputation batch dropped to the lower right.

lesson: Show a batching or scheduling fix by redrawing the same numbered items as length bars before and after, with waste drawn as a white continuation up to the batch maximum and one boxed percentage as the cost.
